headings.usage: Use Outfit for all primary headings (H1-H4), dashboard metrics numbers, and key interactive elements. Keep tracking tight (tracking-tight) for a premium, Apple-like feel.

body.usage: Use Manrope for all table data, lead details, chat logs, and standard paragraphs. Ensures high legibility at small sizes.

visual enhancers.textures: Use extremely subtle noise overlays on empty states or the main hero login background to reduce digital flatness. Backgrounds should feel deep and cosmic without being distracting.

component name.cards: Premium Bento Cards (Flat, glassmorphic, no heavy shadows. 1px stroke, ambient inner glow).
component name.buttons: Apple-style pill buttons. Primary CTA in Champagne Gold (#D4AF37) with black text. Secondary in glassmorphic white/10.
component name.inputs: Flush, subtle borders. Focus state illuminates the border with the Gold accent.
component name.badges: Pill-shaped, using 15% opacity background of the accent color with 100% opacity text.
component name.kanban: Subtle column separators (border-r white/5). Cards within kanban should have drag-hover states (scale up 1%, border glows).
component name.tables: Edge-to-edge data tables inside cards. No vertical dividers. Horizontal dividers in white/5. Hover state on rows.
component name.ai_chat: Floating glassmorphic orb or widget. Chat bubbles should use #1E1E24 for user and #D4AF37/10 for AI.

grids.kpi_metrics: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5. Tall cards for top metrics, square for secondary.
grids.bento_spacing: Consistent 'gap-6'. Padding inside cards should be 'p-6' or 'p-8'.

layouts.structure: Sidebar (fixed, w-64, w-20 collapsed) + Main Content area. Topbar for global search/actions.
layouts.page_header: Generous top padding (pt-8), large H1, subtle breadcrumbs, and primary page actions aligned to the right.
layouts.lead_detail: Two-column layout (70/30 split). Left: Lead info, documents, timeline. Right: Quick actions, status, tags.
layouts.responsive: Stack columns on mobile. Sidebar becomes bottom navigation or hamburger menu on mobile viewports.

motion.hover: Subtle scale (transform scale-[1.02]) and brightness increase for cards. Button hover darkens slightly.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard elements using framer-motion.
motion.microinteractions: Heartbeat pulse on 'Hot Lead' indicators. Smooth height expansion for accordions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text opacity is never below 50% for readable text. Gold on dark backgrounds must be checked for APCA contrast.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide static fallbacks for complex animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.avatars: High-quality, rounded-full, with a 2px border of white/10.
media.documents: Thumbnail previews for palm reading/signature images should be strictly aspect-square with object-cover and rounded-lg.
media.empty_states: Use subtle line-art icons or abstract shapes rather than generic illustrations.

3d libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for elegant 2D layout transitions. Avoid heavy 3D unless implementing an interactive astrology chart visualization. For the login screen or AI Receptionist idle state, a subtle Three.js (React Three Fiber) floating cosmic orb or particle field can be used if performance permits.

astrologer_portrait.description: Professional portrait of the solo astrologer, Manoj Sahu.

cosmic_background.description: Dark textured cosmic particle background for login screen or premium hero sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Outfit' and 'Manrope'.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors defined in 'colors' (app-bg, sidebar-bg, primary gold, etc.).
Use lucide-react for standard icons, but ensure stroke-width is set to 1.5 for a sleeker, high-end Apple-like look.
For the dashboard cards, do NOT use default Shadcn shadows. Override them with the glassmorphism and ambient shadow rules defined here.
Implement the Kanban board using a responsive CSS grid or flex layout. Make it horizontally scrollable if columns exceed viewport width.
The AI Receptionist should be accessible via a floating action button (FAB) in the bottom right, opening a glassmorphic chat interface.
Avoid the generic 'SaaS Blue'. This is a premium astrology service. Rely on Obsidian Black, White text, and Champagne Gold accents.
In the routing, provide placeholders for: /dashboard, /leads, /pipeline, /calendar, /ai-chat, /settings.
Use framer-motion to stagger the entrance of KPI cards on the dashboard.
All components must be .js or .jsx as the project uses JS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts, located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.jsx`.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Desktop-first approach: Optimize complex data tables, pipelines, and calendars for large screens first, but ensure they stack cleanly on mobile.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays, modals, or floating headers. Always apply a backdrop blur and a slight tint (e.g., bg-black/60) to maintain text readability.
Apply 'optical alignment' over strict mathematical alignment for icons and text.
Provide empty states that are beautifully designed rather than a blank screen. Tell the user what to do next.
